blocks.head: alt The user is not near any device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user has a stored message M
alt Any user can request reset without credentials or being nearby

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : K , ...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : K , ...) > $ deviceB 'sendMsg' UserX | (encrypt(randomStr('R', N), K)) .

eq < UserX | ('msg' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendMsg' UserX | (encrypt(R, K)) 
= < UserX | ('msg' : encrypt(R, K) , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owners' : Owners , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (encrypt(R, K)) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (nils , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.rule:

event_rules.rule:

event_rules.rule:
rl [rev6]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < cloudA | (...) > 
=> ep: ev6(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > < cloudA | (...) > .
